title: Open the OTA admin (console)
caption: PF-22. Any role of an active OTA; MFA needed when the OTA is live.

steps.title: Open console
steps.body: Click **Open console** next to the OTA.
steps.expect: A brief "Opening the OTA admin…" page, then the OTA admin's `/bookings` of that OTA (locally http://localhost:3002).

steps.title: Refusals
steps.body: Try with a provisioning, failed or suspended OTA, or a live OTA without MFA.
steps.expect: Back on the overview with `?console=provisioning|failed|suspended&reason=…` explained; live without MFA: `/account/security?console=mfa_required&tenant=…`.

steps.title: Replay
steps.body: Post the same hand-off form twice (DevTools: copy the form).
steps.expect: The second post is refused by the OTA admin ("This console link expired or was already used."): the `ptk:` key is single-use, 60 s.

steps.title: From the OTA admin
steps.body: Open the OTA admin without a session.
steps.expect: The portal's picker "Open the OTA admin" with that OTA selected; a tenant you are not a member of gets a note.
